reportName: Batch 1 Pizza Bruno and Winter Park Biscuit product-photo review
limitations: This audit is item-granular and preserves 82 explicit unsourced entries. It does not certify each photograph's correctness.
Image searches and external URL checks do not establish reproduction rights. Obtain permission before commercial distribution.
No generative image service was enabled; no newly generated food photos are claimed.
Several sourced photos are explicitly from other restaurant branches or from different restaurants and are labeled contextual or representative.
The restaurant's published menus contain seasonal or out-of-stock products; imagery does not assert availability or ingredient safety.
WPBC Burger photo was replaced with a genuine November 2020 photo of that restaurant's Impossible Burger; current menu uses a brioche bun rather than the photographed potato bun.
2026-10-24: Earlier third-party burger URL failed HTTP validation and has been removed.
